title: A Marketplace sale's copy in the business's books: the tenant put back after each write, the portal's own connection refused, and a direct-pay order placed even when its copy fails
why: Gate 5 (decisions/0181 §1, money records; the IT Manager's (11) ticket from the session manager, 2026-11-27). MarketCheckout::writeOrder writes the sale into the business's walled data (decisions/0110) through BusinessData::open, which switched the whole request to that business (Scope::enterBusiness) and never switched back. On live: the tick's reconcile (MarketCheckout.php:756) and the webhook mark several card orders paid in one request, and from the second on Scope.php:19 threw 'already working for a business', so the business never got that order or its payment in Quotes & invoices (only a note on the order); and placing a direct-pay order ran writeOrder outside any try (:391), so a failed copy reached the buyer as an error with no payment instructions though the order was placed. Now: BusinessData::scoped opens the business on its own connection, runs the write, and in a finally sets @tv_tenant to NULL and leaves (Scope::leave, refused for any connection but the one that entered); a request already inside a business (the portal) is refused before anything is written, its own scope untouched; place wraps the write like markPaid does, notes it on the order, and tells the business in its inbox that the invoice wasn't written and why, instead of 'Mark it paid in Quotes & invoices'. Nothing else changes: the same rows, triggers and views (BusinessData.php:110-112).

changes.what: Card orders marked paid together (the tick, the webhook) each reach their business's Quotes & invoices
A direct-pay order whose invoice can't be written is still placed: the buyer gets how to pay; the business's inbox says the invoice wasn't written, with why

checks.write-order: tools/market-tests/write-order.php 15 on MariaDB with the listings realm BusinessData::ensure builds (its triggers and views): two businesses in one request both written, each in its own; owner 0 and no business connection after; @tv_tenant NULL on the connection after and a write on it refused; a throw midway comes back with the scope at 0 and the next business still written; a portal request refused with why, nothing written, its scope and tenant untouched; Scope::leave refuses another connection. On the live code: fails (the second write throws).
checks.write-order-place: tools/market-tests/write-order-place.php 12 on MariaDB, MarketCheckout's place() as built with stand-ins for the outside libraries it passes through: a direct-pay order placed with its invoice and the usual words; a failed copy never the buyer's error, the buyer still told how to pay, the business told why, a note on the order, nothing half-written, the scope at 0; the next business's order in the same request written. On the live code: 6 fail.
